long_biography.plain_text:
Hart immigrated from the Netherlands to the United States as a child and worked full time at a poultry plant while attending James Madison University. The experience helped shape a leadership philosophy grounded in frontline work, personal accountability and support for operating teams.

At Texas Roadhouse, he helped expand a regional restaurant business into a large national chain before leading California Pizza Kitchen, Torchy's Tacos and Red Robin. He now combines chairmanship and operating responsibility at SPB Hospitality with restaurant-focused investing and public-company board service, extending a career built around disciplined growth and organisational culture.
